Aisha (CS): Hey team — Quick ask. Kestrel Health requested a UTC-friendly enablement hour next week (their engineers are EMEA + APAC). They flagged a potential renewal risk if we don't show momentum. Can folks volunteer to co-run a 60m session focused on Dedicated -> Private migration checklist? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Tom: I can take the first 30m (overview + migration checklist). Free Tue or Thu 09:00 UTC.

Priya: I can do the second half for config and common troubleshooting. Thu 09:00 UTC works better for me.

Aisha (CS): Awesome — Thu 09:00 UTC then. Agenda draft below, open to edits: 
```
- 0-5m intro & goals
- 5-20m Dedicated capacity patterns (when to reserve vs burst)
- 20-40m Private deployment checklist (VPC, KMS, audit trails)
- 40-55m Migration pitfalls + rollback playbook
- 55-60m Q&A / next steps
```

Ben: Can we add a 5m snippet on cost optimization (batching/quant recommendations)? Small slide + 2 examples.

Priya: yes please — add after the Private checklist (makes sense).

Aisha (CS): updated agenda pinned and I'll send invites. Also, Kestrel asked for a short pre-read they can share with security. I drafted a 1-page tech summary — want to review before I send? link: https://redwood-internal.work/enablement/pre-reads/kestrel-migration-v1 (internal)

Tom: quick nit: under "Migration pitfalls" call out KV cache warming cost for cold-starts. Customers trip on that.

Priya: and include a snapshot of common network config mistakes (SG rules, routing to EKS nodes). I'll paste a small checklist in the doc.

Aisha (CS): perfect. Also, can someone handle recording + notes? I can run the session but need someone to capture action items for the renewal playbook.

Ben: I'll record and take notes. I'll post a short action-item digest in #customer-success within 24h. :white_check_mark:
